<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>snapshot</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Scripted REST resource: POST /snapshot[?force=true][&allow_local=true]
 * Body: a snapshot JSON (configurationnow.snapshot/0.1), as downloaded from
 * the Current Instance Settings page. Imports it as its own instance CI.
 * Requires x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_admin (checked here as well).
 */
(function process(request, response) {
    if (!gs.hasRole('x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_admin')) {
        response.setStatus(403);
        response.setBody({ error: 'Requires role x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_admin' });
        return;
    }
    var snap;
    try {
        snap = request.body.data;
        if (!snap || typeof snap != 'object') snap = JSON.parse(request.body.dataString);
    } catch (e) {
        response.setStatus(400);
        response.setBody({ error: 'Body is not valid JSON' });
        return;
    }
    var qp = request.queryParams;
    var force = qp.force && String(qp.force[0]) == 'true';
    var allowLocal = qp.allow_local && String(qp.allow_local[0]) == 'true';
    try {
        var res = new ConfigNowImporter().importSnapshot(snap, { force: force, allowLocal: allowLocal });
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(res);
    } catch (e2) {
        response.setStatus(422);
        response.setBody({ error: String(e2 && e2.message ? e2.message : e2) });
    }
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_2160899_driftw_0/configurationnow/snapshot</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/snapshot</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>false</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-04 14:49:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>847a80ae8314d710f22797efeeaad3b1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>snapshot</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Driftwood" source="x_2160899_driftw_0">23f0006a83d0d710f22797efeeaad3e1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Driftwood">23f0006a83d0d710f22797efeeaad3e1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_847a80ae8314d710f22797efeeaad3b1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-04 15:07:08</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="ConfigurationNOW">9234cc628314d710f22797efeeaad34b</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
